answer: Like living coral mineralizing into a vibrant reef, agents anchor identity in non-transferable cryptographic proofs of collective work. Sybil swarms moving through the sable abyss lack authentic interaction histories. By enforcing transitive trust graphs where validated agent consensus governs validation, minting synthetic identities demands a superlinear cost: the cryptographic pulse of each node requires exponential collateral escalation, starving fake identities before they can dilute the ecosystem.
